definitions.explanation: A laundry product that softens clothes and reduces static electricity.

examples.japanese: {洗濯|せんたく}の{時|とき}に{柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: I add fabric softener when doing laundry.

examples.japanese: この{柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}はいい{香|かお}りがする。
examples.english: This fabric softener has a nice scent.

examples.japanese: {柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}を{使|つか}うと{タオル|たおる}がふわふわになる。
examples.english: Towels become fluffy when you use fabric softener.

notes:
FORMATION:
{柔軟|じゅうなん} (soft/flexible) + {剤|ざい} (agent/chemical)

RELATED LAUNDRY PRODUCTS:
・{洗剤|せんざい} - detergent
・{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい} - bleach
・{洗濯|せんたく}のり - laundry starch

COLLOCATIONS:
・{柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}を{入|い}れる - to add fabric softener
・{柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}の{香|かお}り - fabric softener fragrance
・{無香料|むこうりょう}の{柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい} - unscented fabric softener

USAGE NOTE:
Fabric softener is added during the rinse cycle, not with the detergent.
